title: 86 victims. 5 survivors. One of them did it. After 10 years in a coma, you woke up determined to uncover the truth
author: maimahrandev
selftext:
Hey everyone! 👋

I’m a solo indie developer and recently released my first game, **The Survivors**.

The story starts on New Year’s Eve 2016, when a mysterious explosion destroys a villa during a party. Hazem loses his wife in the explosion and falls into a coma. Ten years later, he wakes up with one goal: finding out what really happened that night.

**Only five people survived the explosion.**

**One of them is hiding the truth.**

The game is built around investigating through a phone. You’ll read conversations, receive calls, listen to recordings, search through hidden files, visit fictional websites, solve puzzles, and connect clues to slowly uncover what happened.

I developed and programmed the entire game myself using **React Native**.

# AI disclosure

I used generative AI **for the character portrait images**. As a solo developer, I couldn’t realistically afford to hire actors or photographers for all the characters.



The game is completely free to play and currently available on Google Play.

[https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.thesurvivors.game](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.thesurvivors.game)
